data.body_html:
Planning a Marbella yacht charter vegan catering 2027 experience? Whether you follow a plant-based diet, need gluten-free options, or have other dietary restrictions, our fleet is ready to accommodate. All charters include drinks and snacks, and we can customise menus with advance notice – no extra charge. From the Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) to the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax), every boat departs from Puerto Banús. Let’s make your day on the water delicious and stress-free.

What’s Included in Every Charter

Every booking includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). For vegan or restricted diets, we swap standard snacks for plant-based or allergen-free options. Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) cost €749/2h to €2,299/8h. The Mangusta 80 (white or grey) starts at €4,719 for 4h and includes a free jet ski. All other boats – like the Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) or Canados 86 (26m, 12 pax) – are priced on request via WhatsApp.

Vegan Menu Options on Marbella Yacht Charters

Our standard catering includes light snacks such as olives, nuts, and crisps – all vegan-friendly. For a full vegan menu, we can arrange plant-based tapas, vegan paella, fresh fruit platters, and dairy-free desserts. Simply request when booking. The Lagoon 380 (11.6m, 10 pax) is a great catamaran choice for larger vegan groups. All provisions are sourced locally in Marbella, ensuring freshness.

Gluten-Free and Allergy-Friendly Catering

Gluten-free, nut-free, and other allergy-friendly menus are available. We coordinate with local caterers to provide safe, tasty options. For example, the Pershing 46 (14m, 10 pax) can be stocked with gluten-free bread, crackers, and meals. Always inform us of allergies at booking – we take cross-contamination seriously.

How to Request Dietary Restrictions

When you book any boat – from the Speedboat (7m, 6 pax) to the Maiora 26m (26m, 12 pax) – simply note your dietary needs. We’ll confirm the menu via WhatsApp. No extra fees. For last-minute bookings, we’ll do our best, but 48 hours’ notice guarantees the best selection.

Best Boats for Vegan Catering Charters

All boats can accommodate vegan catering, but some stand out for space and amenities. The Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) has a large saloon and galley. The Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) offers luxury dining. For a smaller group, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) is cosy and efficient. The Bandido (11.5m, 8 pax) is perfect for a sporty day with vegan snacks.

Local Vegan-Friendly Spots Near Puerto Banús

Before or after your charter, explore Marbella’s vegan scene. Try La Concha views from the boat, or dock at Cala del Faro for a swim. Nearby Estepona and Sotogrande have vegan-friendly restaurants. Your skipper can recommend spots along the Golden Mile.

Pricing and Booking for 2027

Prices are fixed for Tier A and Mangusta 80. Other boats: contact us on WhatsApp for a quote. All prices include VAT and catering. For a Marbella yacht charter vegan catering 2027 experience, book early – summer dates fill fast. We’re based at Puerto Banús, ready to set sail.

Frequently asked questions

Can I get a fully vegan menu on a Marbella yacht charter?

Yes. All our charters include drinks and light snacks, but we can arrange a fully vegan menu – from plant-based tapas to vegan paella – with advance notice. Just mention dietary needs when booking.

What drinks are included in the charter price?

Every charter includes water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava. These are all standard – no extra charge. Vegan-friendly wine options can be requested.

Are there gluten-free options available?

Absolutely. We can provide gluten-free snacks and meals on request. Let us know at booking time, and we’ll ensure your catered menu is gluten-free.

Do I need to pay extra for custom catering?

No. Menu customisation for dietary restrictions is included at no extra cost. You only pay the standard charter rate – the food and drink are part of the package.

Which boats are best for a vegan catering charter?

Any boat can accommodate vegan catering. For larger groups, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) or Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) offer plenty of space. For smaller parties, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) is ideal.

Can I bring my own vegan food on board?

Yes, you are welcome to bring your own food. However, we recommend using our catering service to ensure everything is fresh and properly stored. There’s no corkage fee.

How far in advance do I need to request dietary restrictions?

We recommend at least 48 hours’ notice to guarantee your preferred menu. Last-minute requests can often be accommodated, but advance notice ensures the best variety.

Is the skipper able to help with vegan meal preparation?

The skipper is focused on navigation and safety, not food preparation. However, our catering team will prepare and pack your vegan meals – the skipper can serve them on board.

Ready to book your Marbella yacht charter vegan catering 2027 trip? Browse our fleet and let us know your dietary needs. We’ll handle the rest.
